# Pacific Brass Works: new terms
Date: 2026-10-22

Pacific Brass Works sent revised terms effective January 1, 2027:
- Minimum order rises from $1,500 to $2,500.
- Free freight threshold rises from $3,000 to $5,000. Orders below it pay a flat $185 freight charge.
- Payment terms stay at 2% 10, net 30.

What it means for us: In 2026 we placed 61 orders with Pacific Brass. 23 of them were under $2,500 and 38 were under $5,000. At the new terms, those 38 orders would have paid about $7,030 in freight, unless we consolidate into fewer, larger orders.

Dale's note: Pacific Brass has been our best brass and valve vendor for 20 years. Rep is Tom Ishikawa. He has given us exceptions before when asked in person.
